user.title: EZVIZ HP5 Gate Controller
user.description:
Enter your EZVIZ account credentials and the intercom's serial number.

To find the serial number: open the EZVIZ app, select your HP5 device, tap the settings gear icon, then "Device Info" — the serial number is listed there. It is also printed on the physical label/QR code on the back of the device.
